description: Tes Kemampuan Akademik (TKA): the assessment framework for SD/MI/sederajat and SMP/MTs/sederajat (Bahasa Indonesia: text types, text characteristics, reading aspects, competencies and subcompetencies; Matematika: elements, abilities, cognitive levels with thinking processes, content per element and sub-element with scope and notes), item types and forms, test subjects per level with the 20 SMA/SMK electives, the test schedule with minutes per test and session times (WIB/WITA/WIT), score ranges, result categories and the 'istimewa' thresholds.
status: ready (frameworks for SD/MI and SMP/MTs only: no SMA/SMK framework among the sources; the sample questions of 047 part IV are left out)
source: Perka BSKAP 047/H/AN/2025 (2025-07-24), Lampiran parts II–III, and Kepmendikdasmen 56/2026 (2026-03-06), Lampiran BAB IV, VIII and X. Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/kerangka-tka/
procedure: Transcribed as printed into tools/converters/kerangka-tka.py from the PDFs' text layer; python3 -I tools/converters/kerangka-tka.py sources/kerangka-tka data checks every sentence, list item and table cell against the PDF (letters and digits in the page text or in a pdfplumber table cell of 047 p. 7–25 and 56), checks that every table cell of the framework tables is covered, checks minutes and session times against 56 p. 47–48 (also read on the page images), then writes kerangka-tka.json. Printing errors are kept and listed in errata (F-031). Version = date of the newest source (Kepmendikdasmen 56/2026).

format.kerangka-tka.json: source; item_types[{key,label,description}]; item_forms_intro; item_forms[{key,label,description}]; levels[{level,grades,subjects,electives?{choose,options (numbers in electives),note?},framework}]; levels_note; electives[{no,label}]; frameworks[{level,subject,pages,intro,muatan,kompetensi}] — Bahasa Indonesia: muatan{intro,text_types[],text_characteristics[]}, kompetensi{aspects[],competencies[{no,name,description,subcompetencies[]}]}; Matematika: muatan{intro,elements[],notes[]}, kompetensi{intro,abilities[],cognitive_intro,cognitive_levels[{level,name,name_en,processes[{name,description}]}],content_intro,content[{no,element,sub_element,competency,scope[],note?}]}; schedule[{levels,days[{day,label,tests[{name,minutes}],sessions[{session,wib,wita,wit}]}]}]; schedule_notes; scoring{ranges[{levels,min,max,decimals,istimewa_from}],categories,texts,note}; errata[{source,page,printed,reason}]. List items keep their printed punctuation.
